results.title: 1951 Volkswagen Beetle Deluxe Split-Window
results.description: This 1951 Volkswagen Beetle Deluxe is finished in Chestnut Brown over Beige-Brown cloth and is powered by a 1,131cc flat-four paired with a four-speed manual transaxle. Features include 16" steel wheels with hubcaps, chrome bumpers, a cabin heater, and front bucket seats. The car was imported to the US from Germany and acquired by the seller in 2026. This Type 1 Beetle is now offered with a Volkswagen AutoMuseum Foundation certificate and a clean California title in the seller's name.
